scope: oracle-group Top-k diagnostic on consumed development; descriptive geometry only; no geometry threshold fitting or promotion

definitions.numeric_infix_context: target left and right are one-digit tokens; target center is +, -, /, times, div, or cdot
definitions.numeric_equality_context: target left and right are one-digit tokens; target center is =
definitions.all_digit_triplet_control: target left, center, and right are each one digit
definitions.other_numeric_neighbor_context: target left and right are one-digit tokens; center is neither an arithmetic operator, =, nor a digit
definitions.geometry: raw group bounding-box aspect ratio and adjacent horizontal gap divided by center height
definitions.geometry_risk_router: descriptive only; flags a group when its raw bbox aspect ratio is at most the listed threshold
